title: The daily demo-mirror job has no time limit
why: scripts/demo-mirror-daily.py (D295) has timeouts only on its gh and lsof calls, none on the job. Reported by Sim Manager 2026-11-23 13:14 CST: launchd started it at 04:30 CST and nine workers ran at about 51% CPU each for 5 h 54 min, with Mac load 69 to 80, holding Degen's lanes and a Duo lease.
note: Fix: a wall-clock limit on the job that kills its workers and says so. The reporter's figures are unmeasured by triage; no launchd job for it was listed at 13:15 CST.
